csv_null: An empty cell is unknown/not measured. Numeric zero is retained only for actual zero counts, such as logged errors or measured-sample counts.

row_granularity.conversion-runs.csv: One recorded configuration execution, containing 512 CHAMMI arrays or 50 DynaCell windows. Arrays within an execution are not repetitions.
row_granularity.conversion-array-layouts.csv: One scenario-listed array per configuration. Destination geometry may be modeled from the retained script; read destination_layout_basis.
row_granularity.conversion-phase-timings.csv: A coarse job interval encompassing both DynaCell conversions. Never a per-configuration throughput observation.
row_granularity.conversion-summary.csv: One configuration, derived only from conversion-runs.csv.
row_granularity.conversion-plot-data.csv: Each recorded configuration remains present. Plot only valid measured quantities; all memory/throughput pairs are currently ineligible.
row_granularity.conversion-coverage.csv: Near misses, exclusions, failures and scoped coverage gaps; none is treated as a conversion run.

units.capacity_bytes: Uncompressed dtype bytes multiplied by shape, including nominal chunk/shard capacity beyond logical array edges
units.processing_block_nominal_bytes: Geometry of the array/window returned by the source read; a modeled data-array quantity, not measured process memory
units.logical_processed_bytes_from_current_met: Sum of processing-window geometry across indexed arrays, not network or storage traffic
units.elapsed_s: Seconds; absent for every per-configuration conversion
units.throughput_B_s: Bytes per second; absent for every conversion
units.output_allocated_size_human: Unconverted GNU du -sh observation, rounded allocated filesystem blocks; not exact file lengths or payload bytes
units.memory_bytes: Separate process, device and pinned-host quantities; all conversion peak fields are null

evidence_dates.current_metadata_limit: Hashes identify the metadata read during this collection, not the state or content at the historical conversion. No pixel or chunk payload was read.

memory_limits: No application or job conversion memory budget was captured. Damacy scenario max_gpu_memory_mb=8192 is a later reader setting. Replay cache/queue limits and GPU free-memory deltas in other experiments must not populate conversion peak fields.
output_retention: All 100 DynaCell output metadata files were read at indexed paths. CHAMMI checked only the first indexed output metadata path per configuration, all absent; no output data trees were traversed.
source_cache: conversion-source-records.json retains small text files and zarr.json metadata, with original paths and hashes. It contains no image payloads.
